overviews.title: What is Automotive Design? Courses, Fees, Top Institutes, Careers & Salary 2026

blocks.value: Automotive Design courses focus on the physical characteristics of motor vehicles like cars, trucks, motorbikes, etc., and designing their exterior and interior. Students can study Automobile Design courses at the UG, PG, Diploma, Certification and PhD levels .

For admission, students usually have to pass Class 12 from any stream from a recognized board. The admissions are based on both merit and the entrance processes. Some popular entrance exams for the Automotive Design course are NIFT Entrance , CEED, NID Entrance, UCEED , etc.

Some popular Automotive Design colleges that students can explore are the WUD Sonepat, MIT-ADT University, Karnavati University, TISS, IIT Bombay , etc. The average course fee ranges from INR 8,000 to INR 25 Lakh . Some common job profiles one can go for are Automotive Design Engineer, Production Engineer at Automobile Plants, Production Planning and Control Engineer, etc.
The average salary of an Automotive Designer is INR 4.6 LPA in India. If interested, you can continue reading the article for more Automotive Design courses in India.

Automotive Design Admission Process 2026

The Automotive Design admission is based on both merit and entrance exams. Most of the top colleges require entrance exam scores. Others, that provide admission on a merit basis, can conduct separate rounds, like the Personal Interview round, to analyze your abilities.
If you want to know how to get admission in Car Design courses in India, you can go through the general admission process given below.

value: See the eligibility criteria of your desired college and fulfill them.
Next, register on the official website of the college/exam body. Then, fill out the application form, attach the required documents, and pay the application fee to complete the application process.
Appear for the entrance exam (if applicable) at the decided time and venue.
If involved in the merit-based admission process, you may have to wait for the college to verify your application and send a confirmation email if shortlisted.
Stay updated regarding the result dates of the entrance exam, and visit the official site to see the results.

Based on the score or rank, students become eligible for counselling or admission rounds. Fill out the choice forms indicating the preferred colleges and courses, and participate in the counselling session.

faqs.question: Is the NID DAT exam very difficult to crack?

blocks.value: NID DAT, along with NIFT and UCEED are among the most competitive national-level entrance exams in the country. The fact that there are only 425 seats for the B. Des and 347 seats for the M.Des programme makes it very competitive. But that being said, if the candidate prepares well and with the correct strategy, then the NID DAT exam can be cracked. Among the first things the candidate needs to do is prepare a efficient study timetable get familiar with the syllabus and pattern, and use good books as reference material.
